body:
To give some more context: while defining the API, we made a lot of hypothesis (bad). One of them was that MAYBE some users would want to set defaultRefinements while letting the user unselect them.

This is an anti pattern. If you want some default refinements while letting the user unselect them then you just link to color=White, yes the default refinement will be present in the url but no big deal.

The main usage (never seen any other usage) of default Refinement being: "I want to preselect this value, and not show the underlying widget, and not have the url being updated with the default refinement".

If a user still wants to show the underlying widget, then it's his responsibility to not allow unselecting default refinements. Maybe we could enforce that ourself in our default widgets.
